csv_project_name: CMAR for Tule Meadow & Sunrise Apartments Projects
csv_scope_of_work: (RFQ) from general contractors interested in participating as a Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) for two affordable housing projects. The first project is Tule Meadows, new construction, consisting of 22 units of family apartments in (2) two-story buildings a mix of one- and two-bedroom units located in Lovelock, Nevada (Pershing County). The second project is the rehabilitation of existing affordable housing development, Sunrise Apartments consisting of 10 one-story buildings containing 22 units of multi-family housing located in Elko, Nevada.
